project.description:
Hand-crafted glosses - a concise meaning per (character, reading).
PROVENANCE: every gloss in this module is written for the project. No dictionary was transcribed, ported or systematically consulted, so this module carries no third-party licence and is distributable under whatever terms Kranji itself adopts.
Machine-seeded glosses live in kranji-gloss-seed and never here. That module holds a first guess at 7,121 characters that nobody has checked; this one holds several hundred a person wrote and reviewed against the articles that use them. Keeping them apart is what makes "how much of this build has somebody read?" a question the dependency graph answers.
Nothing here depends on that module, and nothing there depends on this one. GlossTsv - the file format both collections read - sits below both in kranji-core.
